correctness.rationale: Every nonzero trace element has a unique x=t z decomposition with Tr(z)=1 and P(tz)=t³N(z). If cube map is invertible, each nonzero y has exactly q preimages. In cubic regime character orthogonality converts the counts to the trace-one norm Gauss sum; in odd characteristic this is a Jacobi sum of nontrivial cubic and quadratic characters, and in even characteristic an additive Gauss sum, both of modulus √q. Variance 2q(q−1) and positivity for q>4 follow. The q=4 trace-one norm split supplies two 6-fibers, one missing 1-fiber, zero fiber 4. Independent polynomial-quotient extension enumerations checked every x for q=2,3,5,7,11,13; the universal proof is character-theoretic.
